title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Transport Corridor 1 (Zhambyl Oblast Section) Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: The Project will reconstruct 125 km of highway sections between Taraz and Korday in Zhambyl Oblast; and improve road operation and maintenance system. This will contribute in sustaining economic development and increasing domestic and international trade growth within Kazakhstan and between Kazakhstan and its trading partners.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Efficient transport network in Taraz-Kulan and Blagoveschenka-Korday road sections

Increased average traffic volume to 2,000 vpd in 2014 from 1,000 vpd in 2007 Progress/Status: The AADT in 2012 was 4,298 vehicles for the Taraz-Kulan section, and 3,911 vehicles for the Blagoveschenka-Korday road section. Data Source: • ASRK transport statistics • MOTC traffic statistics Actual value:

Reduced average travel time to 1 hour in 2014 from 2 hours in 2007 Progress/Status: In 2013, the average travel time was reduced to 6.5 hours between Almaty (about 150 km east of Otar) and Taraz City (about 110 km east of the border between the Zhambyl and South Kazakhstan oblasts). Data Source: • MOTC traffic statistics Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Taraz-Kulan and Blagoveschenka-Korday road sections improved and open to traffic Indicator: Reconstructed 46km road section (km 214-260) on time, within budget, and with pavement IRI < 3 m/km by 2013 Progress/Status: 46-km Blagoveschenka-Korday road reconstruction was completed in June 2013, and now open to traffic. Data Source: • ASRK transport statistics • MOTC traffic statistics
Actual value:

Output: Taraz-Kulan and Blagoveschenka-Korday road sections improved and open to traffic Indicator: Reconstructed 79 km road section (km 404-483) on time, within budget, and with pavement IRI < 3 m/km by 2013 Progress/Status: 79-km Taraz-Kulan road reconstruction completed in November 2012, and now open to traffic. Data Source: • ASRK transport statistics • MOTC traffic statistics
Actual value:
